create_experiment: create an experiment instance with an optional title for running distributed ML training jobs
get_experiment: get an existing experiment by its integer ID from the XManager backend
add_job_to_experiment: add a Job or JobGroup to an experiment as a work unit or auxiliary unit with optional args
add_job_generator_to_work_unit: add an async job generator function to a work unit that receives the work unit and kwargs
package_executables: package executable specs into built executables synchronously or queue them for async packaging
